violation_type.title: Screen Time Activities - Does not include Advertising or Violence (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(5))
violation_type.short_title: Screen Time Activities - Does not include Advertising or Violence
violation_type.typical_finding: During the inspection advertisements were seen playing on screen time used for active play.

finding_variants.text: During the inspection advertisements were seen playing on screen time used for active play.
During the inspection screen time was observed and advertisements were seen being played on the screen.
Upon arrival to the operation, the main room tv was on a local station and airing commercials. Note: this was brought into compliance when the tv was turned off.
During the inspection screen time was observed, an ad started to play while children were present.
